symptom: Chinese OCR needs recognition data and a usable text-layer font.
applies_to: macOS OCRmyPDF 17.11.0, Tesseract 5.5.3, Chinese and English scanned pages
cause: Recognition languages and CJK PDF rendering fonts are separate dependencies.
resolution: Check chi_sim/chi_tra/eng availability for the requested language
Check the selected renderer and CJK font when copied text is missing
Write a new output bundle and verify extracted Chinese plus source checksum

verification.check: Two-page scanned test produced searchable English and Chinese with Noto Sans SC; page count and original checksum preserved

limitations: One Chinese character was misrecognized in the test. This validates pipeline operation, not perfect OCR or actual thesis paper quality.
